此工作流程将图像生成 4 个不同的照片版本它的。

逆向工作流程：照片2动漫

结果比较

→ 全尺寸图片在这里 ←

安装和依赖

  1. 安装WAS 节点套件自定义节点；

  2. 安装ControlNet 辅助预处理器自定义节点；

  3. 下载ControlNet 艺术线条型号（两者.pth 和.yaml 文件），并将其放入“\comfy\ComfyUI\models\controlnet”中。

  4. （可选）安装WD 1.4 标记器自定义节点；

  5. （可选）安装SD提示阅读器自定义节点；

  6. 下载并打开此工作流程；

  7. （有点重要）查看下面的“资源和替代品”部分以获取推荐的额外内容。

你只需要WD 1.4 标记器如果您想自动询问图像以进行提示。

你只需要SD提示阅读器从现实世代的元数据中获取提示。

如果两者都没有，您就必须手动编写图片提示。

资源和替代品

工作流程可以根据您最喜欢的模型进行调整。有一个名为“质量前缀“ 靠近每个模型装载机。只需将最适合模型的通用关键字放入肯定（第一个字符串）和否定（第二个字符串）中即可。请注意，KSampler 参数针对所选模型进行了彻底测试和微调。

一般现实模型: 超现实主义。如何替代：使用您所知道的最通用的现实模型。PicX_real作品。将照片写实主义指导关键字添加到“质量前缀“节点。

“老电影”模式: Lomo风格。如何替代：任何风格独特的车型。复古现实模型的例子：懒惰混合+, 美好的旧时光, Z_phyr 记住。将模型作者推荐的通用质量标签添加到“质量前缀“节点。

真实感 + 逼真的 3D 模型: 模拟疯狂 + 真实卡通-写实。如何替代：用“逼真，但不太通用”的二人组（例如精致）和“多才多艺，但不太现实”（比如异种GASM）模型。将模型作者推荐的通用质量标签添加到“质量前缀“节点。

乌尔赞模型: 麦格米克斯 + LEOSAM 的 HelloWorld 胶片颗粒。与上述相同，但亚洲面孔倾向较强。下一张照片适用于两个插槽。将模型作者推荐的通用质量标签添加到“质量前缀“节点。

VAE: vae-ft-mse-840000-ema-修剪。标准，推荐。如果您的结果对您来说对比度太高且太亮，请考虑使用音调范围压缩器解码。

嵌入: 错误提示版本2（可选），坏手5（可选）。

如何使用

  1. 选择从何处获取图像和提示，并将图像、正负图像的节点连接到“>> 在此处路由您的输入 <<” 组：

    • 默认情况下，使用手动书面提示

    • 打开（Ctrl + M）并连接“WD 1.4 标记器" 节点从图片生成提示

    • 打开（Ctrl + M）并连接“SD提示阅读器" 节点从元数据获取提示

  2. 运行它！

注意事项

将艺术图片变成照片般的图像比相反更难。工作流程最适合 SD 生成的图片，而不是真正的动漫帧。如果结果看起来仍然很动画，请将“Retro”和两个“Semireal”KSampler 节点中的降噪增加 0.1。

This workflow takes an image togenerate 4 different photo versionsof it.

Reverse workflow:Photo2Anime

Comparison of results

→ full size image here ←

Installation and dependencies

  1. InstallWAS Node Suitecustom nodes;

  2. InstallControlNet Auxiliary Preprocessorscustom nodes;

  3. DownloadControlNet Lineartmodel (both.pth and.yaml files), and put it into "\comfy\ComfyUI\models\controlnet".

  4. (optional) InstallWD 1.4 Taggercustom node;

  5. (optional) InstallSD Prompt Readercustom node;

  6. Download and open this workflow;

  7. (kind of important) Check "Resources and substitutions" section below for recommended extras.

You only needWD 1.4 Taggerif you want to interrogate image for prompt automatically.

You only needSD Prompt Readerto get prompts from metadata of realistic generations.

With neither, you'd have to write the prompt for picture manually.

Resources and substitutions

Workflow was made with possibility to tune with your favorite models in mind. There is the node called "Quality prefix" near every model loader. Just put most suitable universal keywords for the model in positive (1st string) and negative (2nd string). Note that KSampler parameters are thoroughly tested and fine-tuned for selected models.

General realistic model: epiCRealism. How to substitite: with the most versitile realistic model you know.PicX_realworks. Add photorealism-guiding keywords to "Quality prefix" node.

"Old film" model: LomoStyle. How to substitite: with any model with unique style. Examples of retro realistic models:LazyMix+, Good Old Days, Z_phyr Remember. Add universal quality tags recommended by the model author to "Quality prefix" node.

Photorealism + realistic 3D models: Analog Madness + RealCartoon-Realistic. How to substitite: with a duo of "photorealistic, but not too versitile" (likeRefined) and "versitile, but not too realistic" (likeXenoGASM) models. Add universal quality tags recommended by the model author to "Quality prefix" node.

Ulzzang models: MagMix + LEOSAM's HelloWorld Film Grain. Same as above, but with strong tendency for asian faces.NextPhotoworks for both slots. Add universal quality tags recommended by the model author to "Quality prefix" node.

VAE: vae-ft-mse-840000-ema-pruned. Standard, recommended. If your results are too contrast and bright for you, consider usingTone Range Compressorto decode.

Embeddings: bad-prompt-version2(optional),bad-hands-5(optional).

How to use

  1. Choose where to get image and prompts from and connect nodes for image, positive and negative into ">> Route your inputs here <<" group:

    • By default, manual written prompts are used

    • Turn on (Ctrl + M) and connect "WD 1.4 Tagger" node to generate prompt from picture

    • Turn on (Ctrl + M) and connect "SD Prompt Reader" node to get prompts from metadata

  2. Run it!

Note

Turning artistic pictures into photo-like images is harder than the other way around. Workflow works best with SD generated pictures, not real anime frames. If results still look anime, increase denoise by 0.1 in "Retro" and both "Semireal" KSampler nodes.
